name: io.github.inkwell-finance/dagon-mcp
title: Dagon Inference
description: Uncensored LLM inference: list models, chat, create keys, buy credits with Solana USDC.

environmentVariables.name: DAGON_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Dagon account key (gk_...) for balance, purchases and chat

environmentVariables.name: DAGON_WALLET_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Solana secret key for self-signed USDC purchases; use a dedicated hot wallet

environmentVariables.name: DAGON_TREASURY_WALLET
environmentVariables.description: Trusted Dagon treasury address, required for purchases (9rMdbu4KdLWH2nPXbzhm9HTKaibGZ2ckakQbW1wPh6KK)

environmentVariables.name: DAGON_SOLANA_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC for submitting unsponsored purchases

environmentVariables.name: DAGON_MAX_PURCHASE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Largest purchase per call in USD (default 50; 0 disables purchases)

environmentVariables.name: DAGON_MAX_PURCHASE_USD_PER_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Purchase cap per server process in USD (default 200)

environmentVariables.name: DAGON_MAX_PURCHASE_USD_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Purchase cap per UTC day in USD (default 200)

environmentVariables.name: DAGON_SPEND_LEDGER
environmentVariables.description: Path of the daily spend ledger file

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <Dagon account key (gk_...)>, for balance, purchases and chat; dagon_models and dagon_create_key work without it. The remote server never holds a wallet: purchases return the unsigned transaction to sign.
